title: NAS Scrub Error Summary
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`), uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=truenas:pool
| stats latest(scrub_errors) as scrub_errors, latest(last_scrub_status) as scrub_status by pool
| where scrub_errors>0 OR scrub_status!="finished"
| sort - scrub_errors
description: Summarises scrub outcomes for your storage pools so data-integrity issues are visible long before a disk officially fails.
value: Home storage gets trusted with irreplaceable family media and backups; a scrub-status panel gives that trust a real verification loop.
implementation: Forward ZFS pool health and scrub summaries; review after each scheduled scrub and investigate any non-clean result.
visualization: Storage table of pools by scrub status and error count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether your storage pool checks found any problems instead of quietly assuming the disks are fine.
